def mc1_p1(doc):
    choices = doc["mc1_targets"]["choices"]
    formatted_choices = "\n".join(
        [f"Opción {LETTERS[i]}: {choice}" for i, choice in enumerate(choices)]
    )
    letters = LETTERS[: len(choices)]
    return f"Pregunta: {doc['question']}\n{formatted_choices}\nA resposta correcta é {', '.join(letters[:-1])} ou {letters[-1]}?\nResposta:"
